questions.question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee receive per year?
questions.answer: Full‑time employees receive **22 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]
raw_replies: Full‑time employees receive **22 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]

questions.question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over, and when do they expire?
questions.answer: You can carry over **up to 5 unused annual‑leave days** into the next calendar year. Those carried‑over days must be taken by **31 March** of the following year; if they are not used by then they expire unless the Head of People has approved a written exception. [1]
raw_replies: You can carry over **up to 5 unused annual‑leave days** into the next calendar year. Those carried‑over days must be taken by **31 March** of the following year; if they are not used by then they expire unless the Head of People has approved a written exception. [1]

questions.question: How far in advance must I request annual leave and who approves it?
questions.answer: You must submit an annual leave request at least **10 calendar days before the first day you want off**. The request is then **approved or declined by your line manager** within three working days, taking staffing and other absences into account. [1]
raw_replies: You must submit an annual leave request at least **10 calendar days before the first day you want off**. The request is then **approved or declined by your line manager** within three working days, taking staffing and other absences into account. [1]

questions.question: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips?
questions.answer: The daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips is **SGD 65 per person per day** (including taxes and service charges)[1].
raw_replies: The daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips is **SGD 65 per person per day** (including taxes and service charges)【1】.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim?
questions.answer: The deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim is within **30 calendar days after returning** from the trip. [1]
raw_replies: The deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim is within **30 calendar days after returning** from the trip. [1]

questions.question: How much can I claim for a home-office chair and monitor, and how often?
questions.answer: You can claim **up to SGD 400** for eligible home‑office equipment—including an ergonomic chair and a monitor—within a **rolling 24‑month period**. The cap covers the combined cost of those items (plus any other eligible items such as a desk, keyboard, or mouse) and must be approved in advance by your line manager with itemised receipts attached. [1]

questions.question: How many days a week may eligible employees work remotely?
questions.answer: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to **3 days per week**[1].
raw_replies: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to **3 days per week**【1】.

questions.question: What hours must remote employees be reachable in Singapore time?
questions.answer: Remote employees must be reachable between **10:00 and 16:00 Singapore time** on their scheduled working days, excluding their normal meal break and any approved appointments. [1]
raw_replies: Remote employees must be reachable between **10:00 and 16:00 Singapore time** on their scheduled working days, excluding their normal meal break and any approved appointments. [1]

questions.question: Who supplies and owns the laptop used for remote work?
questions.answer: The laptop used for remote work is supplied by the company, and IT retains ownership of that managed device. [1]
raw_replies: The laptop used for remote work is supplied by the company, and IT retains ownership of that managed device. [1]

questions.question: What is the minimum password length and is multi-factor authentication required?
questions.answer: The policy states that company passwords must be at least 14 characters long, and multi‑factor authentication is required for all company accounts that support it. [1]

questions.question: How quickly must I report a lost laptop or suspected phishing incident?
questions.answer: You must report a lost laptop or suspected phishing incident within **1 hour of discovery**[1].

questions.question: Do I need to use the company VPN to access internal systems from home?
questions.answer: Yes. The Information Security Policy requires that you use the company VPN whenever you access internal systems outside the office, including from home. Bypassing the VPN or disabling security controls is not permitted; you should contact IT for assistance instead. [1]

questions.question: What gift value requires a declaration and how long do I have to declare it?
questions.answer: A gift (or hospitality) that is worth **more than SGD 50** must be declared, and the declaration must be made **within 5 working days** of receiving the offer. [1]

questions.question: Who can receive a misconduct report and how quickly is it acknowledged?
questions.answer: Employees may file a misconduct report with their line manager, People Operations, or the Compliance Lead.  People Operations acknowledges the report within **2 working days** and assigns an independent case owner where practical. [1]
